findings.detail: Night latent persists under configured night_correlation. slot_state is reset from night_state at every night start; slot innovations occur only at slot iteration.
findings.forecast_implication: A separate night latent can preserve cross-night information lost by a scalar observation-time retention model.
findings.limitation: Scalar log C approximates product/ratio of three independently clipped fields. C/E remains nonidentifiable from many score patterns.

findings.detail: For an observable slot all three site fields and efficiency are generated once and remain constant throughout the slot. Airmass/lunar and per-target directional coverage still evolve.
findings.forecast_implication: Same-slot causal feedback has stronger persistence than continuous phi**fraction retention; C-band and raw Z must remain separate.

findings.detail: Baseline E is an independent uniform draw at each observable slot, with instrument fault, earthquake, and global event multipliers applied.
findings.forecast_implication: Previous E does not predict next-slot jitter, while fault/earthquake overlays may persist.

findings.detail: Each V4 forecast notice is a deterministic projection of one real forecastable event onto touched night_date values in its issued coverage window. There are no V4 false-positive, miss, probability, or random timing-error draws.
findings.forecast_implication: The future opportunity model can use absence/presence and continuous multi-night support as source-proven event constraints.
findings.limitation: This proves coarse event support. It does not identify amplitude, sector boundaries, background closure, or force_close merely from rain/storm labels.

findings.detail: V4 weather slots use stream_seed(config, v4.weather.slots, 1000). Hashed streams use independent SHA256-derived 128-bit seeds.
findings.forecast_implication: Public catalog state cannot recover weather RNG by legacy offset arithmetic.

experiment: Causal score-only feedback features from our cpu_calendar_witness_20261003 outputs, recomputed with strong frozen Policy._ingest_result. Official public local truth used only as training/validation/test labels.
runtime: No LLM, GPU, network, truth/evaluator access in solver. Production source and Git index untouched.
limitations: Historical actions were generated by an older CPU policy, but features are recomputed using the selected same-source estimator. This isolates forecast quality conditional on action history.
Whole-season comparisons use the identical frozen strong CPU source and environment for both arms.
The approximate clock retains fractional-slot decay, rather than exact slot-boundary transition counting. Same-slot holding is a separate source-derived hypothesis; it is not claimed tested here.
Only four public local cards were used; predictive error alone is not sufficient for adoption.
